subtotal.description: Marks carried by this section. Must equal the sum of count * marks_each across the composition.

description: The pattern an examination paper must follow: total marks, sections, and the composition of each section by question type and marks.

duration.description: Time allowed, as printed on the paper, e.g. '3 hours'.

locale.description: Spelling locale the auditor lints against.

long_answer_requires_word_limit.description: When true, every long-answer question in a paper spec must declare a word_limit. Set false for subjects (e.g. mathematics) where long answers are worked solutions rather than prose.

name.description: Human-readable name of the pattern, e.g. 'Secondary English - 80 marks'.

title: PaperForge Blueprint
